acquisition.observed_download_signal: WIX site publishes periodic new-number announcement XLS/PDF files; these are supplemental, not a full fitment dataset.

confirmed_claims: Official WIX lookup explicitly supports Pass Car/Light Truck application search.
The application UI instructs users to select Make, Year, and Model/Engine to obtain a part listing.
The catalog home advertises more than 16,000 filters.
The catalog exposes competitor interchange and manufacturer part-number search in addition to vehicle application lookup.
